checks.name: Thirty institutional JPEG derivative bodies match retained SHA/size, normal TLS and manual-reading inventory
Fourteen profiles retain fifteen voice claims, compound elements and roles without scalar weights or inferred star placements

Twelve real natal contexts attach168 source-star profiles to HHC positions and match168 real iztro major-star branch/palace coordinates
Symbolic office labels remain attached when physical placement is elsewhere, with no office-based placement or element score
Caller mutation and explicitly partial placement cannot corrupt source profiles or infer a missing palace
Public HTML, clean site, current engine and public modules remain byte-identical to4718-file release
